lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Zn2 (reduced formula Mg7Zn) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg and Zn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg/Zn coordination distances near 2.99–3.17 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
